assumptions.obligation: The AXI Manager drives AWVALID, WVALID and ARVALID low while i_rst_n_axi is active (AXI4 Manager reset rule, with reset of the Manager coordinated by the SoC).
Once AWVALID is high it stays high, and AWID/AWADDR/AWLEN/AWSIZE/AWBURST/AWCACHE/AWPROT stay stable, until AWREADY is high (AXI4 VALID/READY handshake).
Once WVALID is high it stays high, and WDATA/WSTRB/WLAST stay stable, until WREADY is high; W may be presented before AW.
Once ARVALID is high it stays high, and ARID/ARADDR/ARLEN/ARSIZE/ARBURST/ARCACHE/ARPROT stay stable, until ARREADY is high.

The AXI Manager asserts WLAST exactly on W beat AWLEN+1 of the corresponding accepted write. Beats sent before AW are counted. Constrained only while an accepted AW has outstanding W data and the count has not overshot.
